name: WooCommerce
description: WooCommerce store REST API integrated with WordPress REST API for store data.
auth_notes: Consumer key/secret generated per store, used as Basic auth username and password; OAuth 1.0a and a /wc-auth/v1/authorize key-delivery flow also exist.
gate_detail: API is per self-hosted store; the store admin enables the REST API and generates keys. No vendor approval or payment stated. Sandbox not described.
api_scope: CRUD over store data in JSON including coupons, customers, orders, products, taxes and webhooks, with bulk endpoints.
mcp_notes: No MCP server appears in the provided sources.
blocker_detail: Needs store admin access to the specific WooCommerce install; no vendor gate.

evidence.quote: Pre-generated keys can be used to authenticate use of the REST API endpoints.
The username when authenticating is your consumer key
The password when authenticating is your consumer secret
the REST API must be enabled under WooCommerce > Settings
v3 fixes the OAuth implementation to be compliant with the Oauth 1.0a specs

issues: Each store is separately hosted; access depends on that store's admin.
MCP absence is inferred from silence in sources.
No independent second pass completed for this app.
